description: This file defines the class 'EmailsDataAddress', which provides methods for constructing data arrays related to email addresses, including signatures, within the SuiteCRM application. It interacts with email signature resolver classes and handles encoding conversions.

classes.name: EmailsDataAddress
classes.description: A class providing methods to generate email address data arrays with signatures and other related information in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getDataArray
methods.description: Generates an associative array containing email address data, including signatures, for use in SuiteCRM's email functionalities.

methods.name: getDataArrayAttributes
methods.description: Prepares and encodes email address attribute data, such as reply-to, from, and name fields, ensuring UTF-8 encoding.
